We go into Paramaribo, Surinam, because I need to book some tours. The cat calling is crazy tho and maybe I just need to put some pants on XD. 
Hope you enjoy this Suriname travel vlog but DON'T click the following link: http://bit.ly/1KKCs8V (you just might be stuck with me by subscribing)
If you're on a roll here's a travel vlog with a party in Paramaribo: https://youtu.be/86bhmL6x9sk
